As a result, these questions will not appear in the review screen. You deploy an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster named AKS1. You need to deploy a YAML file to AKS1. Solution: From Azure CLI, you run the kubectl client. Does this meet the goal?

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。kubectl 是 Kubernetes 的原生命令列用戶端，透過 kubectl apply -f 即可把 YAML 資源清單部署到 AKS1；Azure CLI 也可用 az aks install-cli 與 get-credentials 完成前置設定。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。kubectl 正是部署 YAML 的正確工具。

question: Note: This question is part of a series of questions that present the same scenario. Each question in the series contains a unique solution that might meet the stated goals. Some question sets might have more than one correct solution, while others might not have a correct solution. After you answer a question in this section, you will NOT be able to return to it. As a result, these questions will not appear in the review screen. You deploy an Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster named AKS1. You need to deploy a YAML file to AKS1. Solution: From Azure CLI, you run azcopy. Does this meet the goal?

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。azcopy 是儲存體資料複製工具，只能在檔案系統與 Azure 儲存體之間搬移資料。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。azcopy 完全不認識 Kubernetes API，無法把資源清單套用到叢集；正確工具是 kubectl。

Some question sets might have more than one correct solution, while others might not have a correct solution. After you answer a question in this section, you will NOT be able to return to it. As a result, these questions will not appear in the review screen. You have an Azure virtual machine named VM1 that runs Windows Server 2016. You need to create an alert in Azure when more than two error events are logged to the System event log on VM1 within an hour. Solution: You create an Azure storage account and configure shared access signatures (SASs). You install the Microsoft Monitoring Agent on VM1. You create an alert in Azure Monitor and specify the storage account as the source. Does that meet the goal?

explanations.A: Incorrect. 錯誤。儲存體帳戶只能作為診斷資料的存放位置，Azure 監視器無法對存放在儲存體帳戶中的事件執行記錄查詢警示。
explanations.B: Correct. 正確。要對事件記錄的內容設定條件式警示，必須把資料送進 Log Analytics 工作區，再以工作區為來源建立記錄查詢警示；以儲存體帳戶為來源無法達成。

question: You download an Azure Resource Manager template based on an existing virtual machine. The template will be used to deploy 100 virtual machines. You need to modify the template to reference an administrative password. You must prevent the password from being stored in plain text. What should you create to store the password?

options.A: an Azure Key Vault and an access policy
options.B: an Azure Storage account and an access policy
options.C: a Recovery Services vault and a backup policy
options.D: Azure Active Directory (AD) Identity Protection and an Azure policy

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。ARM 範本可以在參數中以 reference 語法指向金鑰保存庫中的祕密，部署時才即時取值，密碼因此從未出現在範本或參數檔中；保存庫需設定存取原則並啟用「用於範本部署」。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。儲存體帳戶不是祕密管理服務，ARM 範本也沒有從儲存體帳戶安全取用祕密的原生機制。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。復原服務保存庫用於備份與災難復原，不存放祕密。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。Identity Protection 偵測身分風險，Azure 原則負責資源合規，兩者都與存放密碼無關。

question: You plan to automate the deployment of a virtual machine scale set that uses the Windows Server 2016 Datacenter image. You need to ensure that when the scale set virtual machines are provisioned, they have web server components installed. Which two actions should you perform? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.D: Modify the extensionProfile section of the Azure Resource Manager template
options.E: Create a new virtual machine scale set in the Azure portal

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。自訂指令碼延伸模組需要一個可存取的指令碼檔案（通常放在儲存體帳戶或公開 URL），因此必須先上傳安裝 Web 伺服器元件的設定指令碼。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。自動化帳戶用於 Runbook 與設定管理，並非擴展集在佈建時執行指令碼的機制。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。Azure 原則負責治理與合規稽核，不會在 VM 佈建時安裝軟體。
explanations.D: Correct. 正確。擴展集範本的 extensionProfile 區段用來宣告要套用在每個執行個體上的延伸模組（例如自訂指令碼延伸模組），新佈建的執行個體就會自動執行該指令碼。
explanations.E: Incorrect. 錯誤。題目要求的是「自動化部署」，改用入口網站手動建立與此目標相違。

question: You create an App Service plan named Plan1 and an Azure web app named webapp1. You discover that the option to create a staging slot is unavailable. You need to create a staging slot for Plan1. What should you do first?

options.A: From Plan1, scale up the App Service plan
options.B: From webapp1, modify the Application settings
options.C: From webapp1, add a custom domain
options.D: From Plan1, scale out the App Service plan

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。部署位置是「標準 (Standard)」層級以上才提供的功能，免費與共用層完全沒有、基本層也不支援。必須先垂直擴充方案的定價層，選項才會出現。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。應用程式設定調整的是環境變數與連線字串，不會解鎖部署位置功能。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。自訂網域與部署位置是兩個各自獨立的功能。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。水平擴展增加的是執行個體「數量」，而部署位置取決於定價「層級」，因此要 scale up 而非 scale out。

question: You plan to move a distributed on-premises app named App1 to an Azure subscription. After the planned move, App1 will be hosted on several Azure virtual machines. You need to ensure that App1 always runs on at least eight virtual machines during planned Azure maintenance. What should you create?

options.A: one virtual machine scale set that has 10 virtual machines instances
options.B: one Availability Set that has three fault domains and one update domain
options.C: one Availability Set that has 10 update domains and one fault domain
options.D: one virtual machine scale set that has 12 virtual machines instances

explanations.A: Correct. 正確。虛擬機器擴展集預設會把執行個體分散到 5 個更新網域，計畫性維護一次只影響其中一個網域，也就是最多 10÷5 = 2 台同時重新啟動，因此至少有 8 台維持執行，剛好滿足需求且執行個體數最少。
explanations.B: Incorrect. 錯誤。只有一個更新網域意味著所有 VM 屬於同一維護批次，維護時會全部一起重新啟動。
explanations.C: Incorrect. 錯誤。單一錯誤網域讓所有 VM 共用同一組硬體，可用性設計不良；而且題目也沒有提供足夠的 VM 數量資訊來保證八台在線。
explanations.D: Incorrect. 錯誤。12 台雖然也能滿足「至少八台」（12÷5 取整後一次影響 3 台，剩 9 台），但比 10 台多用了兩個執行個體，成本較高而非最佳解。
